Managed IT services help organizations maintain their IT environments, troubleshoot technical problems, manage infrastructure, and plan technology improvements. Zeus System Technologies is a partner for stable, secure, and efficient IT operations.

Request a Consultation Explore Services

What managed IT services mean

Every organization depends on technology, and that technology needs ongoing care. Managed IT services give you a partner responsible for keeping your systems in working order, helping your people when something goes wrong, and advising you on what to improve next.

Depending on your needs, that can be a one-off fix, scheduled maintenance, a defined project, or a continuing arrangement. You choose how much of the IT workload to hand over.

  • Maintain your IT environment

    Keep computers, servers, and networks looked after on an agreed basis.

  • Troubleshoot technical problems

    Get help diagnosing and resolving faults that interrupt your work.

  • Manage infrastructure

    Have the systems your team relies on administered and kept in order.

  • Plan improvements

    Receive advice on upgrades and technology decisions before you commit.

Service offerings

Ten areas of support that can be combined to match the way your organization works.

  • IT helpdesk and troubleshooting

    A point of contact for technical problems, with diagnosis and resolution of issues affecting your users.

  • Desktop and laptop support

    Support for staff computers, including faults, setup, and day-to-day usage problems.

  • Server administration and maintenance

    Routine administration and upkeep of the servers your organization depends on.

  • User account and access administration

    Creating, changing, and removing user accounts and the access that goes with them.

  • Network monitoring and troubleshooting

    Checking network health and tracking down connectivity problems.

  • Software installation and configuration

    Installing and configuring the software your team needs to work.

  • Preventive maintenance

    Scheduled checks and upkeep aimed at catching problems before they interrupt work.

  • Backup and recovery planning

    Helping you decide what to back up, how, and how to restore it when needed.

  • IT asset and infrastructure support

    Support in keeping track of equipment and the infrastructure it runs on.

  • Technology advisory and IT planning

    Practical advice on technology choices, upgrades, and longer-term IT planning.

Who benefits

Managed IT support suits many kinds of organization.

  • Small and medium-sized businesses

    Teams that need dependable IT support without building a full in-house department.

  • Offices

    Offices with shared computers, networks, printers, and servers to keep running.

  • Institutions

    Schools, public bodies, and other institutions with many users and systems.

  • Organizations with internal or outsourced IT

    Organizations that want extra capacity alongside an in-house team, or a partner to carry the IT workload.

Engagement options

Choose the arrangement that fits. Options are subject to availability and are agreed with you before work begins.

  • Ad hoc support

    Help when a specific problem or request comes up.

    Best for occasional needs.

  • Scheduled maintenance

    Planned visits or checks on a regular basis.

    Best for steady upkeep.

  • Project-based support

    A defined piece of work with an agreed scope, such as a migration or setup.

    Best for one-off improvements.

  • Ongoing managed services

    Continuing responsibility for the day-to-day care of your IT environment.

    Best for long-term partnership.

Frequently asked questions

What are managed IT services?

Managed IT services place the day-to-day care of your technology with a dedicated partner. That can include helpdesk support, maintenance, server and network administration, and advice on planning improvements.

Do you offer 24/7 support?

Support hours and how quickly we respond depend on the engagement agreed with you. We will confirm exactly what is available when we discuss your requirements.

Can you work alongside our internal IT team?

Yes, where it suits your organization. Some clients want extra capacity or specific skills next to an in-house team; others want us to carry the full IT workload.

Can I get help with a one-off problem?

Ad hoc support is one of our engagement options, subject to availability. Describe the problem in the enquiry form and we will advise on next steps.

How are engagements priced?

We do not publish fixed prices. The scope of support, the size of your environment, and the type of engagement all affect the quote, which we prepare after assessing your needs.

How do I get started?

Send an enquiry describing your environment and what you need help with. We will respond to discuss your requirements and recommend an approach.
